description: Subscribe MindBase to a new RSS feed. New entries are auto-fetched every 60 minutes and compiled into wiki pages. Use this when the user says things like "subscribe me to <url>", "follow this blog", "add this to my feeds", or shares a feed URL.

project.description: Optional project name to group entries under

tags.description: Tags applied to all entries from this feed
